rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Male Montseny giant striding from one documented mountain peak to another.

visual_requirements.description: Enormous humanoid giant spanning mountain summits, natural one head, two arms and two legs, fully clothed.
A dynamic stride across the Montseny peaks; small displaced grit at foot contact, no invented magic.
Les Agudes and Turó de l’Home, with summit forests far below.

aura: Documented mountain-spanning bodily scale and movement c01/c04; no magical aura.
artistic_choices: Weathered dark wool tunic, trousers and plain belt are editorial modest clothing, not asserted traditional iconography.
Low angle and tight near leg create overwhelming scale; storm cloud lighting is atmosphere and not storm control.
No drinking river in this selected moment; not claiming concurrent feats.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Pare Esmè, the Catalan giant of the Montseny who strides between mountain summits.
ANATOMY: one enormous humanlike male giant, one head two eyes two arms two legs, massive weathered face, completely opaque rough dark wool tunic and trousers and plain belt; plain bare feet. His TWO feet span distinct mountainous peaks: one is planted on Les Agudes, the other is stepping onto Turó de l'Home. [pare-esme-c01, pare-esme-c04]
MOMENT: STRIDE forward toward the viewer across a vast valley, near knee thrust toward camera, head bent down with fierce concentration, arms balancing the force of the step. Show the whole giant prominently, not a far-off silhouette.
POWER: documented mountain-spanning size and leaping/striding; grit and ordinary dust jump from his foot contacting the summit, no invented magical power. [pare-esme-c01, pare-esme-c04]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle from a ridge immediately below his near foot, body fills nearly the entire square, tiny real-scale pine forests far beneath both feet establish immense documented size; both mountain-top foot contacts readable.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single break of late sunset under dark natural rainclouds, hard antique-gold rim light on face and wool, windblown ordinary mist in the valley.
SURFACE: rough skin, coarse woven wool, wet granite, scattered dust and pine needles, tactile painterly surfaces.
SETTING: jagged Montseny summits Les Agudes and Turó de l'Home across wooded valleys in Catalonia. [pare-esme-c01, pare-esme-c03, pare-esme-c04]
MOOD: overwhelming awe, immense bodily power, confrontational giant movement, never ordinary man walking, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Not a giant stone statue; a living flesh-and-blood giant.
